sections.title: format_date()
sections.body:
Format datetime in different styles:
    - 'short': MM/DD/YY
    - 'long': Month DD, YYYY
    - 'full': Weekday, Month DD, YYYY at HH:MM AM/PM
    - 'iso': ISO 8601 format

```python
def format_date(dt: datetime, style: str) -> str:
    """
    Format datetime in different styles:
    - 'short': MM/DD/YY
    - 'long': Month DD, YYYY
    - 'full': Weekday, Month DD, YYYY at HH:MM AM/PM
    - 'iso': ISO 8601 format
    """
    formats = {
        "short": "%m/%d/%y",
        "long": "%B %d, %Y",
        "full": "%A, %B %d, %Y at %I:%M %p",
        "iso": "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S",
    }
    return dt.strftime(formats.get(style, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"))

dt = datetime(2024, 7, 4, 14, 30, 45)
print(f"Date: {dt}")
print(f"Short: {format_date(dt, 'short')}")
print(f"Long: {format_date(dt, 'long')}")
print(f"Full: {format_date(dt, 'full')}")
print(f"ISO: {format_date(dt, 'iso')}")

# ============================================================================
```

sections.title: days_until_birthday()
sections.body:
Calculate days until next birthday

```python
def days_until_birthday(birth_month: int, birth_day: int) -> int:
    """Calculate days until next birthday"""
    today = date.today()
    next_birthday = date(today.year, birth_month, birth_day)

    # If birthday already passed this year, use next year
    if next_birthday < today:
        next_birthday = date(today.year + 1, birth_month, birth_day)

    return (next_birthday - today).days

# Test with different birthdays
birthdays = [(5, 15), (12, 25), (1, 1)]
for month, day in birthdays:
    days = days_until_birthday(month, day)
    bday_date = date(2024, month, day)
    print(f"Birthday on {bday_date.strftime('%B %d')}: {days} days until next one")
```

sections.title: convert_timezone()
sections.body:
Convert datetime between timezones
    offset is in hours (e.g., -5 for EST, 5.5 for IST)

```python
def convert_timezone(dt: datetime, from_offset: float, to_offset: float) -> datetime:
    """
    Convert datetime between timezones
    offset is in hours (e.g., -5 for EST, 5.5 for IST)
    """
    # Make timezone-aware if naive
    if dt.tzinfo is None:
        from_tz = timezone(timedelta(hours=from_offset))
        dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=from_tz)

    # Convert to target timezone
    to_tz = timezone(timedelta(hours=to_offset))
    return dt.astimezone(to_tz)

# EST to IST conversion
est_time = datetime(2024, 1, 15, 10, 0, 0)
ist_time = convert_timezone(est_time, -5, 5.5)
utc_time = convert_timezone(est_time, -5, 0)

print(f"EST (UTC-5):  {est_time}")
print(f"UTC (UTC+0):  {utc_time}")
print(f"IST (UTC+5.5): {ist_time}")
```

sections.title: schedule_meetings()

```python
def schedule_meetings(
    start_time: datetime, duration_minutes: int, break_minutes: int, num_meetings: int
) -> list:
    """Schedule multiple meetings with breaks"""
    meetings = []
    current = start_time

    for i in range(num_meetings):
        end = current + timedelta(minutes=duration_minutes)
        meetings.append((current, end))
        # Add break before next meeting
        current = end + timedelta(minutes=break_minutes)

    return meetings

start = datetime(2024, 1, 15, 9, 0, 0)
meetings = schedule_meetings(start, 30, 15, 4)

print("Meeting schedule:")
for i, (start, end) in enumerate(meetings, 1):
    print(f"  Meeting {i}: {start.strftime('%I:%M %p')} - {end.strftime('%I:%M %p')}")
```

sections.title: parse_date_flexible()
sections.body:
Parse dates in multiple formats

```python
def parse_date_flexible(date_string: str) -> datetime:
    """Parse dates in multiple formats"""
    formats = [
        "%Y-%m-%d",
        "%m/%d/%Y",
        "%d-%m-%Y",
        "%B %d, %Y",
        "%d %B %Y",
        "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
    ]

    for fmt in formats:
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(date_string, fmt)
        except ValueError:
            continue

    raise ValueError(f"Unable to parse date: {date_string}")

date_strings = [
    "2024-01-15",
    "01/15/2024",
    "15-01-2024",
    "January 15, 2024",
    "15 January 2024",
]

print("Parsing various date formats:")
for ds in date_strings:
    try:
        parsed = parse_date_flexible(ds)
        print(f"  '{ds}' -> {parsed.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}")
    except ValueError as e:
        print(f"  '{ds}' -> ERROR: {e}")
```

sections.title: calculate_working_hours(), get_weekdays()
sections.body:

```python
def calculate_working_hours(
    clock_in: datetime, clock_out: datetime, break_minutes: int = 60
) -> float:
    """Calculate working hours minus break time"""
    total_time = clock_out - clock_in
    total_minutes = total_time.total_seconds() / 60
    working_minutes = total_minutes - break_minutes
    return working_minutes / 60

# Test cases
times = [
    (datetime(2024, 1, 15, 9, 0), datetime(2024, 1, 15, 17, 30)),
    (datetime(2024, 1, 15, 8, 30), datetime(2024, 1, 15, 16, 45)),
]

for clock_in, clock_out in times:
    hours = calculate_working_hours(clock_in, clock_out)
    print(
        f"Clock in: {clock_in.strftime('%I:%M %p')}, "
        f"Clock out: {clock_out.strftime('%I:%M %p')}"
    )
    print(f"  Working hours: {hours:.2f}")

# ============================================================================

def get_weekdays(start: date, end: date) -> list:
    """Get all weekdays in date range"""
    weekdays = []
    current = start

    while current <= end:
        if current.weekday() < 5:  # Monday = 0, Friday = 4
            weekdays.append(current)
        current += timedelta(days=1)

    return weekdays
```

```python
def get_weekends(start: date, end: date) -> list:
    """Get all weekend days in date range"""
    weekends = []
    current = start

    while current <= end:
        if current.weekday() >= 5:  # Saturday = 5, Sunday = 6
            weekends.append(current)
        current += timedelta(days=1)

    return weekends

start_date = date(2024, 1, 1)
end_date = date(2024, 1, 14)

weekdays = get_weekdays(start_date, end_date)
weekends = get_weekends(start_date, end_date)

print(f"From {start_date} to {end_date}:")
print(f"  Weekdays: {len(weekdays)}")
print(f"  Weekend days: {len(weekends)}")
```

sections.title: time_ago(), get_quarter()
sections.body:
Format datetime as 'X time ago' (e.g., '2 hours ago') Get quarter (1-4) for a given date

```python
def time_ago(dt: datetime) -> str:
    """Format datetime as 'X time ago' (e.g., '2 hours ago')"""
    now = datetime.now()
    diff = now - dt

    seconds = diff.total_seconds()

    if seconds < 60:
        return f"{int(seconds)} seconds ago"
    elif seconds < 3600:
        return f"{int(seconds / 60)} minutes ago"
    elif seconds < 86400:
        return f"{int(seconds / 3600)} hours ago"
    elif seconds < 2592000:  # 30 days
        return f"{int(seconds / 86400)} days ago"
    elif seconds < 31536000:  # 365 days
        return f"{int(seconds / 2592000)} months ago"
    else:
        return f"{int(seconds / 31536000)} years ago"

# Test with different times
now = datetime.now()
test_times = [
    (now - timedelta(seconds=30), "30 seconds"),
    (now - timedelta(minutes=5), "5 minutes"),
    (now - timedelta(hours=2), "2 hours"),
    (now - timedelta(days=3), "3 days"),
]

print("Time ago formatting:")
for dt, expected in test_times:
    print(f"  {expected} -> {time_ago(dt)}")

# ============================================================================
# EXERCISE 9: Quarterly Date Calculator
# ============================================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("EXERCISE 9: Quarterly Date Calculator")
print("=" * 70)

def get_quarter(dt: date) -> int:
    """Get quarter (1-4) for a given date"""
    return (dt.month - 1) // 3 + 1
```

sections.title: get_quarter_dates(), timestamp_to_datetime()
sections.body:
Get start and end dates for a quarter Convert Unix timestamp to datetime with optional timezone

```python
def get_quarter_dates(year: int, quarter: int) -> tuple:
    """Get start and end dates for a quarter"""
    start_month = (quarter - 1) * 3 + 1

    if quarter == 4:
        end_month = 12
        end_day = 31
    else:
        end_month = start_month + 2
        # Get last day of month
        next_month = date(year, end_month + 1, 1)
        last_day = (next_month - timedelta(days=1)).day
        end_day = last_day

    start_date = date(year, start_month, 1)
    end_date = date(year, end_month, end_day)

    return start_date, end_date

today = date.today()
quarter = get_quarter(today)
print(f"Today ({today}) is in Q{quarter}")

print("\n2024 Quarters:")
for q in range(1, 5):
    start, end = get_quarter_dates(2024, q)
    print(f"  Q{q}: {start} to {end}")

# ============================================================================
# EXERCISE 10: Timestamp Converter
# ============================================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("EXERCISE 10: Timestamp Converter")
print("=" * 70)

def timestamp_to_datetime(ts: float, tz_offset: float = 0) -> datetime:
    """Convert Unix timestamp to datetime with optional timezone"""
    tz = timezone(timedelta(hours=tz_offset))
    return datetime.fromtimestamp(ts, tz=tz)
```

sections.title: datetime_to_timestamp()
sections.body:
Convert datetime to Unix timestamp

```python
def datetime_to_timestamp(dt: datetime) -> float:
    """Convert datetime to Unix timestamp"""
    return dt.timestamp()

# Current timestamp
current_ts = time_module.time()
print(f"Current Unix timestamp: {current_ts:.2f}")

# Convert to different timezones
utc_dt = timestamp_to_datetime(current_ts, 0)
est_dt = timestamp_to_datetime(current_ts, -5)
ist_dt = timestamp_to_datetime(current_ts, 5.5)

print(f"UTC:  {utc_dt}")
print(f"EST:  {est_dt}")
print(f"IST:  {ist_dt}")

# Convert back
dt = datetime(2024, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
ts = datetime_to_timestamp(dt)
print(f"\n{dt} -> timestamp: {ts}")
```
